title: Q13
description:
Read: Exo 29:1-9, Exo 29:29-35

Where the English says consecrate, the Hebrew is "fill the hand," and the Greek says "perfect the hands." It is done to a man already chosen.

a) Perfected forever by one offering: if that is the word used for filling a priest's hands, what is being completed, given that He had no sin to be cured of?
